summary: A new Halloween redemption code CANDYTIDE is available for all players until November 30. Redeeming the code grants 5 Heliolite Dice, 20 Thunder Gummy, 1 Mini Stamina Bread, and 5 million Gold. To redeem it in-game, tap the plus icon in the top right, go to Settings, then Service, and enter the code under Redemption Codes.
